review_target: generic English conference research paper; no named venue
workflow_scope: Independent Codex review using field-general criteria from academic-paper; this is not a claim that Claude-specific orchestration, hooks, full-pipeline certification or stage confirmations were run.

sources.use: field-general assessment guidance; no venue binding

criteria.name: originality
criteria.what_to_look_for: A precise, evidence-supported contribution distinct from relevant prior work, including valid boundary or negative-result contributions.
criteria.what_triggers_block: No identifiable research contribution or a core novelty claim contradicted by the documented prior work.
criteria.what_triggers_warn: Contribution is identifiable but weakly differentiated or framed more broadly than its evidence.

criteria.name: methodological_rigor
criteria.what_to_look_for: Question, design, data construction, evaluation units, controls, metrics and analysis are traceable and the limits of inferences are explicit.
criteria.what_triggers_block: A design or reporting error makes a main inference invalid or unreconstructable.
criteria.what_triggers_warn: A fundamentally interpretable design has unresolved method details, denominator definitions, comparison conditions or reproducibility gaps.

criteria.name: evidence_sufficiency
criteria.what_to_look_for: Material claims map to appropriate data or verified sources; negative and countervailing results are included; uncertainty and the assessed population match the claims.
criteria.what_triggers_block: Core claims are unsupported, favorable results are selected while contrary results are concealed, or conclusions exceed the actual evaluation population.
criteria.what_triggers_warn: Core claims are supported but secondary claims or bounded factual details lack adequate evidence or locators.

criteria.name: argument_coherence
criteria.what_to_look_for: The research question, method, experiments, results and implications form a consistent chain across the title, abstract, introduction and conclusion.
criteria.what_triggers_block: The argument contains consequential self-contradiction or assigns evidence to a contribution it does not test.
criteria.what_triggers_warn: The central argument is coherent but local terminology, cross-references or transitions create ambiguity.

criteria.name: writing_quality
criteria.what_to_look_for: Precise readable academic prose, clearly introduced terminology, informative figures and tables, and consistent citations and formatting.
criteria.what_triggers_block: The presentation prevents reliable interpretation of the research or identification of the main results.
criteria.what_triggers_warn: The draft is readable but local wording, acronyms, figure/table labeling, citation presentation or organization needs repair.
